data.navTitle: 化合物柜、氧化物卡与硫标签
data.title: Six labels inside a materials case
data.goal: Six labels inside a materials case
data.situation:
A materials case held labelled samples and formula cards. Water appeared as a compound, while a separate card explained that an oxide contains oxygen combined with another element. A carbon dioxide card drew attention to the two oxygen atoms in its molecular formula. Farther along, a yellow sulfur sample stood beside a labelled sulfide sample. Jo read the chemical names before looking at the colours. The attendant reminded them that a chemical is a substance, not a word that automatically means poison. They could read the labels through the glass without handling anything in the case. Jo: Are all these chemicals dangerous?
Attendant: The word itself does not tell you that. Each substance has its own properties.
Maya: This card says dioxide.
Attendant: Look at the full name and formula on the card.

readingBlocks.zh: 材料柜装着标记样本和化学式卡片。水作为化合物出现；另一张卡说明氧化物含有与其他元素结合的氧。二氧化碳卡让人注意其分子式中的两个氧原子。再往前，黄色硫样本旁放着标记的硫化物样本。乔先读化学物质名称，再看颜色。工作人员提醒她们，chemical 指一种物质，并不自动意味着毒物。她们隔玻璃读标签，无须触碰柜内物品。

readingBlocks.zh:
乔：这些化学物质都危险吗？
工作人员：这个词本身不能说明危险与否，每种物质都有自己的性质。
玛雅：这张卡写二氧化物。
工作人员：看看卡上的完整名称和化学式。

glossary.zh: 由两种或更多元素化学结合形成的化合物
glossary.note: 这里是化合物名词；a chemical compound。
glossary.example: Water was labelled as a compound.

externalEvidence.definition: (chemistry) a substance formed by chemical union of two or more elements or ingredients in definite proportion by weight

glossary.zh: 氧与另一种元素化合而成的氧化物
glossary.note: 氧与另一种元素结合形成的氧化物。
glossary.example: The card explained what an oxide contains.
glossary.exampleZh: 卡片说明氧化物包含什么。

externalEvidence.definition: any compound of oxygen with another element or a radical

glossary.zh: 某一元素与两个氧原子组成相应式量的二氧化物
glossary.note: 如 carbon dioxide；名称表示相应化学式中有两个氧原子，不要求都是独立分子。
glossary.example: The card showed carbon dioxide as an example of a dioxide.
glossary.exampleZh: 卡片把二氧化碳作为二氧化物的例子。

externalEvidence.definition: an oxide containing two atoms of oxygen in the molecule

glossary.example: A yellow sulfur sample stood in the case.

externalEvidence.definition: an abundant tasteless odorless multivalent nonmetallic element; best known in yellow crystals; occurs in many sulphide and sulphate minerals and even in native form (especially in volcanic regions)

glossary.zh: 硫与其他元素形成的硫化物
glossary.note: 硫化物，与单质硫 sulfur 区分。
glossary.example: A sulfide sample had its own label.
glossary.exampleZh: 硫化物样本有独立标签。

externalEvidence.definition: a compound of sulphur and some other element that is more electropositive

glossary.zh: 一种具有特定组成或性质的化学物质
glossary.note: 名词 a chemical 指一种化学物质；形容词 chemical 修饰名称、反应等。化学物质并非全都有毒。
glossary.example: Each chemical had a separate label.
glossary.exampleZh: 每种化学物质有单独标签。

externalEvidence.definition: material produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules
